**Deadhead — Gold Line play surface** (Director notes). **Cargo maglev — not a passenger train.**

World Scene inject (flag `goldLineScene`) creates **Scenes → Deadhead → Gold Line** on first GM load of a **new** world only.

**Locked architecture (new worlds):**
- **Level background** = interior motion MP4 (`map-gold-line-interior-loop.mp4`), video loop + autoplay.
- **ONE Tile** = roofs (`goldLineRoofs`): `map-gold-line-roofs-loop.mp4`, 6472×958, start **x=0 y=0 elev=1**, locked, occlusion **NONE**.
- No interior motion tile. No second background. Inject deletes leftover `goldLineInterior` tiles.

`resolveSrc`: loop.mp4 → loop.webm → still.webp. Stills are a valid playable layout if a loop is missing.

**Director — hide roofs:** hide the roofs tile when playing inside (Tiles layer → eye). Unhide for the roof Recall bail. Occlusion stays off. Walls and lights are **Michael manual**.

**Live worlds are sacred.** If a scene already has flag `goldLineScene`, the module returns immediately — it never rewrites background, tiles, levels, walls, lights, or dimensions. `{ force: true }` is GM-opt-in only and overwrites the live scene; do not run it on a dressed map.

**Plate:** 6472 × 958. **Grid:** 208 px = 5 ft. Art has **no baked grid**.

**Lock:** CyberMaps Hammerhead dual stitch. Do not drop a generated train.

SoR: `docs/directors/runs/deadhead/DEADHEAD-GOLD-LINE.md` (sidecar `GOLD-LINE-CARGO-REMAP.md`).

text.markdown:
**Cargo maglev — not a passenger train.** Dual Hammerhead plate read as six zones, left → right = aft → forward (nose right). Crew boards **aft** and works **upstream** (rightward).

| Plate zone (L→R) | Hammerhead part | Deadhead zone |
|---|---|---|
| **L1** | Left aft cargo | **AFT FREIGHT** — board here (drone sling); freight Enforcers |
| **L2** | Left connector | **FREIGHT PASSAGE** — ridged containers; worker drone on a leash |
| **L3** | Left forward + cab | **MID CONSOLE BOOTH** — sealed ARG booth; local overrides (not the host) |
| *(coupler)* | Synthetic join | Maglock gangway or non-walkable (Director call) |
| **R1** | Right aft cargo | **BLACK-CONTAINER AISLE** — container steel; no native meat |
| **R2** | Right connector | **SECOND-TO-LAST — COURIER** — green crates; sealed capsule + wafer |
| **R3** | Right forward + cab | **FRONT CAB** — drive end; Trace host |

**Wire on this plate:** Track 1 maglocks / lights / cams on every chamber (mid booth = local overrides); Track 2 capsule lock + Watchdog ICE in the **second-to-last** car; Trace host **R3** cab.

**Opposition (LOCK — 5 security + 1 worker drone):** **2** freight Enforcers (ARG Corporate Enforcer) in **L1**; **1** worker drone (Integrity 24) in **L2**; **1** ARG Security Officer at the mid booth; **1** ARG guard (second Security Officer token) with the capsule in the **second-to-last** car; **1** ARG Response Lieutenant in the **R3** cab. Black-container aisle = 0 native meat.

Six zones — do not invent a seventh car. Mid-consist double-cab (L3) is the Hammerhead artifact — narrate a sealed ARG booth rather than a second drive cab.

Players still learn the exact capsule **chamber** only on a **great success** in discovery; otherwise they search. Chamber cards: @UUID[Compendium.draw-steel-ghostwire.runs.JournalEntry.gwDhSessionChap0.JournalEntryPage.gwDhSessCarByCar]{Gold Line — Car-by-Car}.

After Escape / Recall, cut to the **Nightjar Market** Scene — the exchange never runs on this plate.

**Director:** hide the **Roofs (overhead)** tile when playing inside. Walls/lights = Michael manual — do not overwrite.
